description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This vital leadership role supports the Director of Nursing in overseeing clinical operations, ensuring the highest standards of patient care, and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff. If you are a compassionate leader with a commitment to excellence in long-term care, we encourage you to apply.

As an ADON, you will play a crucial role in staff supervision, quality assurance, and regulatory compliance. This position offers a competitive salary range and the opportunity to make a significant impact on the lives of residents. We are looking for a proactive individual who can contribute to a supportive and high-performing nursing team.
requirements: Previous experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care facility
Demonstrated leadership and supervisory experience in nursing
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
Knowledge of state and federal regulations governing skilled nursing facilities
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000, based on experience and qualifications.
